original_test_intent: Validate all sixteen R-suffix fan-speed channels across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web evidence against the approved cooling specification.
original_method: The cooling owner defines SPD and R, expands sixteen exact names, maps each to chassis position, fan module and rotor/tach input, defines its F-family relationship and state-qualified RPM criteria, and automation performs passive collection.
manual_activity: The cooling owner defines SPD/R, maps sixteen R channels to modules, rotors and tach inputs, approves R-specific RPM envelopes and F/R balance rules under recorded controller state, then reviews all evidence.
required_inputs: Authoritative SPD meaning and whether R denotes rear rotor, reverse/rear fan, return channel or another vendor meaning
Exact SPD_FAN1_R through SPD_FAN16_R names and fitted population
Per-index chassis zone/position, module serial/FRU, connector and R rotor/tach input map
Pairing to SPD_FAN1_F through SPD_FAN16_F plus permitted speed delta/ratio if applicable
R-channel RPM units, scaling, tolerance, refresh, zero/not-present/stale and fault semantics
R-specific ranges by PWM, cooling zone, system power, workload, outlet temperature and ambient state
SDR entity/name/description plus Sensor List/Web mapping and same-target BMC/fan-controller/spec revisions
Secret-safe collectors and independent cooling/power/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Resolve sixteen exact R names; neither endpoint range nor procedure shorthand is executable proof
Do not infer R meaning or count F-suffix readings as R coverage
Bind every R channel to physical module, rotor/tach and cooling zone
Use an R-specific envelope; do not assume equality with F rotor RPM
Do not command fans, service modules, change cooling policy/thresholds/BMC or clear logs
Stop on missing/zero/stale RPM, pair imbalance outside approved rule, fan fault, outlet thermal rise or incomplete views
agent_execution_scope: Verify unique source, SPD/R definition, sixteen-name expansion and F/R map
Verify fan population, R rotor/tach topology and same-target identity read-only
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List, sixteen exact R results and BMC Web
Compare identity/RPM/state/freshness with passive PWM, paired-F, fan health, inlet/outlet temperature and SEL context
Perform no F substitution, fan control/service, workload, cooling/BMC mutation, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Define SPD/R and approve sixteen R rotor/tach positions
Approve F/R pairing plus R-specific balance and speed criteria
Provide PWM/power/outlet-temperature-qualified RPM ranges and fault semantics
Review all sixteen R channels and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use sixteen owner-approved exact R names, then collect complete secret-safe IB/OOB SDR/Sensor List plus Web and passive PWM/F-pair/outlet-thermal context.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES SIXTEEN R-CHANNEL ROTOR MAP, F/R PAIR CONTRACT AND R-SPECIFIC RPM ENVELOPE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a 16-row map from exact R sensor to module, second/rear rotor tach, paired F channel, zone and approved control-state envelope, then reconcile complete views with inlet/outlet thermal context.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Distinguishes R-channel performance from F-channel performance rather than treating suffixes as symmetric labels.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: F-suffix readings may diagnose a paired module but do not replace any R sensor or its R-specific acceptance rule.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The downstream/rear rotor in a counter-rotating or dual-rotor assembly may intentionally run at a different speed and react differently to restriction; a copied F limit can hide degradation or create false alarms.

project_override_considerations: If R is not a second/rear rotor, the owner must supply the actual semantics and relationship. Unfitted positions require explicit not-present behavior and must not be silently omitted.
expected_evidence: Approved SPD/R definition and exact sixteen-name/fitted-population list
Sixteen chassis/module/R-rotor/tach/zone identities plus F pairing
R-specific RPM scale, freshness, fault and PWM/power/outlet-temperature-qualified criteria
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus sixteen exact R results
BMC Web, same-target proof and passive PWM/paired-F/fan-health/inlet-outlet-temperature/SEL context
No-fan-control/no-module-service/no-cooling/no-threshold/no-reset/no-write/no-clear audit, statuses, hashes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and Procedure use two range shorthands for the same R-suffix family; exact expansion remains an owner input, but the intended sixteen-channel purpose is consistent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The passive sixteen-channel R-speed review is identifiable after the owner supplies suffix semantics, rotor mapping and state-qualified criteria under ED-35/36.

review_improvement: Adds R-specific rotor mapping, outlet-side thermal context and asymmetric F/R balance semantics instead of mirroring the preceding F-channel review mechanically.
independent_technical_reasoning: A rear or second rotor sees airflow already altered by the upstream rotor and chassis restriction, so its normal speed and failure signature need not match the F channel. Pair identity and an R-specific envelope are necessary to distinguish normal asymmetric operation from a degraded rotor.
